data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of technical provisions, including foreign exchange (48,439)

prior_year_events.impact_description: On 31st December 2021 the Syndicate entered into a 100% whole account loss portfolio transfer reinsurance with Syndicate 3500 for its 2020 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) for 2019 and Prior YOAs
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2019 and Prior underwriting years have reinsured into Syndicate 3500 as of 1st January 2022.

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate 2468 does not have material insurance exposure to COVID-19 related claims and its 2021 financial results have not been meaningfully impacted by this pandemic, this is consistent with the 2020 financial results.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2468 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 48.4 million for the year ended 31 December 2021, representing a 10.3% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily due to a general re-estimation of technical provisions, with no material adverse impact from COVID-19 related claims. The syndicate also completed a 100% whole account loss portfolio transfer reinsurance for its 2020 year of account as of 31 December 2021, and its 2019 and prior underwriting years reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500 as of 1 January 2022, indicating the ongoing run-off of its business.
raw_causal_phrases: Syndicate 2468 does not have material insurance exposure to COVID-19 related claims and its 2021 financial results have not been meaningfully impacted by this pandemic, this is consistent with the 2020 financial results.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross premium mix includes negative values for some lines of business and for the total, indicating returns or reductions in premiums. The claims development triangle on page 11 shows negligible movement for prior years, which is inconsistent with the explicit 'Change in estimates of technical provisions' figure on page 14. The figure on page 14 is taken as authoritative, as the triangle may reflect ultimate estimates rather than outstanding claims, or be affected by the Loss Portfolio Transfer and Reinsurance to Close events.
